description: Returns the FixMyContract glossary entry for one clause type (for example "auto-renewal", "indemnification", "non-compete"): what the clause does, what to watch for and what is commonly asked for, plus how often it appears in the CUAD v1 dataset where available. General information about the clause type, not an assessment of any particular contract.

clause.description: Clause type name or glossary slug, e.g. "limitation of liability" or "auto-renewal-clause".
